description: Implementation of ApiKeyService managing API keys, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and caching logic within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: ApiKeyServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class for managing API keys, including CRUD operations, validation, caching, and event handling within the platform.

methods.name: handleEvictEvent
methods.description: Handles eviction events for API key cache.

methods.name: saveApiKey
methods.description: Creates or updates an API key with optional validation and value assignment.

methods.name: findApiKeyById
methods.description: Retrieves an API key by its ID.

methods.name: findApiKeysByUserId
methods.description: Finds API keys associated with a specific user.

methods.name: findApiKeysByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of API keys for a user.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an entity (API key) by its ID.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an entity (API key) by its ID.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an entity (API key) by ID.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all API keys associated with a tenant.

methods.name: deleteByUserId
methods.description: Deletes all API keys associated with a user.

methods.name: findApiKeysByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves API keys for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findApiKeyByValue
methods.description: Finds an API key by its value, utilizing cache.

methods.name: generateApiKeySecret
methods.description: Generates a new API key secret with prefix and secure token.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is API_KEY.
